meta.title: Approximate mixing water, angular aggregate
meta.source: CIE308 Ch4 Part B slides (Dr. M. Tawk), after ACI 211.1; verify against ACI 211.1-91 and PCA Design and Control of Concrete Mixtures
meta.notes: Rows are the midpoints of the slump bands 25-50 mm (37.5), 75-100 mm (87.5), 150-175 mm (162.5); band edges are in mixing_water_slump_bands. Values are for angular aggregate; subtract shape_reduction. No value at 150 mm NMAS for 150-175 mm slump.
